nodes.title: The Keyhole Filled
nodes.summary: The Major demands your account signed. You say a key in the inside lock fills the keyhole you saw the lamp through, pull the master's key from Lucius Carrington's waistcoat and set it in the study lock from the gallery; the solicitor, widow and doctor kneel and see nothing. He strikes you; Nathaniel Yardley pins his arms while you name him there, the tallow stub behind him, Fairbrother never asked.
nodes.image: the master's key standing in the study lock, the keyhole gone dark
who: the master's valet of forty years

nodes.title: The Next Cart
nodes.summary: The carriage carries Lucius Carrington and Cornelius Ellingham away through the thaw, key and stub with them, the unsigned will never named. Reginald Fairbrother takes the house keys from Nathaniel Yardley, who pays your wages, writes your character and says a woman who put her hand in a gentleman's pocket cannot be kept. Lavinia Netherby hauls your box to the cart, muttering she never thought you had it in you.
nodes.image: the master's last tray going down the back stairs in the valet's hands
who: the master's valet of forty years
